source_checks.requirement: Q1: What does the six-gate review cover?
source_checks.evidence: 01 / CLEARANCE BEFORE OPTIMIZATION A finished-looking page still needs evidence. The six-gate method separates access, meaning, and credibility. A complete review records each condition and its evidence. G0 + G1 / ACCESS Can the page exist in search? Crawlability and index eligibility examine the response, initial HTML, discovery signals, directives, and canonical identity. Google’s technical requirements ↗ G2 + G3 / MEANING Does it answer the right question? Query alignment and semantic coverage compare the page with a frozen list of questions, sections, and entities for the target query. Inspect the evidence worksheet ↗ G4 + G5 / CREDIBILITY Can the claims be checked? Citation mapping and trust signals look for supporting authority, a responsible publisher, contact, and appropriate structured identity. Google’s people-first content guidance ↗ THE RULE All six gates need evidence for a full PASS. Missing evidence fails the relevant gate. This independent framework does not promise Google indexing or rankings. See what a report contains ↗

source_checks.requirement: Q2: Is the request an instant automated assessment?
source_checks.evidence: A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS Know what you’re signing up for. Does the form run an instant automated check? + No. It saves a page-clearance review request with your URL and target query. The evidence must be collected and assessed before a real verdict can be issued. The sample report is an example of the format. What do the six gates cover? + G0 Crawlability, G1 Index Eligibility, G2 Query Alignment, G3 Semantic Coverage, G4 Citation Map, and G5 Trust Signals. A full PASS requires evidence for every condition; missing evidence fails the relevant gate. Does getting a resource subscribe me to the newsletter? + Only if you choose the separate, unchecked newsletter option. A resource request and a newsletter request are recorded distinctly. You can withdraw your newsletter request using the preference link shown after signup. Will I receive an email immediately? + This private preview records requests and unlocks resource downloads immediately. It does not send a report, a confirmation email, or a newsletter automatically. Newsletter requests remain pending email confirmation until the delivery workflow is connected. Is a PASS a promise that my page will rank? + No. The method assesses structural eligibility for a specified query. Indexing and rankings are not guaranteed. Google’s technical requirements also distinguish eligibility from guaranteed indexing. Can I start without requesting a full review? + Yes. Choose a checklist or worksheet in the resource library, or join the newsletter. Those paths do not require a page URL or a review request.
